matches.text: dyverse necessaries bought, viz. for a beame of iron and a paire of scales to weighe beyf in, iij s.; for a brush for his Lordship’s apparell, xvij d.; for a cater’s baskette, ij s. 11j d.; for a male pyllion and gyrthes, ij s. vj d.; for vj stone cuppes, xviij d.; 1j° hang locks, xij d.; a fyre shovell for his Lordship’s chamber, xij d.; for a fyre porre, xij d.; a handbasket, viij d.; for a skreene, iiij s.; for iiij°? glasse plates, ij s. viij d.; for 1j° drincking <IA_FTS_MATCH>glasses</IA_FTS_MATCH>, 1j s. iiij d.; and for xxiiij°? yeards of sackwebbe to make sacks on, xs. 1iij d. In all as in the said bookes may appeare: xxxiiij s.
Item five crosse bowes; two rackes; two <IA_FTS_MATCH>glasses</IA_FTS_MATCH>; tenn arrowes; seaven peeces of drere* harnesse; one table standing upon tressells. [Toftal:] vj li. xiijs. ij d.
